note: One SCB variable per writer claim, all 2020 in register 1. EXTENDED binds book example-codes (001, 002) by its 'Example codes' list 001/missing/999: the old test's blank member '' 'Unspecified' is code 999 here (blank codes stay out of fixtures until #1274), so the replaced counts 3 checked / 1 matched / 2 nonconforming / overlap 1/3 hold unchanged, and the book row carries the old fixture's prose fields and 2000-2020 validity. SENTINEL binds the same book, whose curated sentinel_codes list 99 'Not applicable': 98 stays a nonstandard extension, 99 a sentinel keeping its source label. SCOPED certifies 09350 'Okänt' by [[coding.sentinel]] for 2020 (the certificate's compile and stale claims are 8a's coding-checked-entries-apply-then-go-stale-on-drift); the book keeps code_count 2. TYPELESS has a blank Datatyp and a 2020 list 01/1 (01 Participation delivered twice), plus a 2022 delivery without one; it sits in this build by cost, not by prefix. Successions: older-codes -> example-codes (2000); the old explicit-split SUN chain (curated sun1996 -> sun2000-niva, derived onwards); a/b/current/future from the predecessor-projection test with the undated edge from b and the as-of-year (2026) edge from a, so current's single pointer is a only while an edge dated at the as-of year counts as active (min(a, b) would be a either way in the old order); future's edge is dated 2100, far past any as-of year. sni2000 'SNI 2000' and sni2020 'Another classification 2020' share no stripped name, so no edge. Revisit current/future if CLASSIFICATION_SUCCESSION_AS_OF_YEAR passes 2100 or drops below 2026.
fails_if: extended/sentinel/scoped: `resolve_classification_conformance` (source_classifications.py) files a curated sentinel code as a nonstandard extension (or a scoped certificate's member as a book code), or `write_resolved_catalog` writes the source label of a matched code into the book or adds 09350 to classification_code; successions: `resolve_classification_successions` (catalog_dependencies.py) stops deriving the vintage chain, derives an edge between books whose names differ beyond the year, or `_prepare_classification_succession` (resolved_catalog.py) projects a predecessor from an edge dated after CLASSIFICATION_SUCCESSION_AS_OF_YEAR or treats an edge dated at that year as inactive; typeless: the writer or formation drops a value set whose state has no known data type
